## Lacy's Direct Quotes

- GQ (Gordon, June 23, 2022): the "renaissance" quote above. Lacy also said he intended the a cappella section to sound like he was "singing directly to" the listener.
- The Guardian (D'Souza, December 22, 2022): Lacy described the lyrics as "a play on confidence." He said the narrator moves from feeling not good enough to feeling "almost too good" but "still down."
- The Guardian (same piece): Lacy initially found the official sped-up version "gross" but agreed to it in hopes of helping the song reach No. 1.
- Rolling Stone (Jeff Ihaza, October 20, 2022, https://www.rollingstone.com/music/music-features/steve-lacy-bad-habit-grammy-preview-1234607474/): Lacy said the refrain represents fans wanting something from him that he didn't realize he had.

## Writing and Credits

- **Writing changes:** Tyler, the Creator suggested changing the chorus wording to make it "more memorable." Lacy adopted the change, which removed a repeated word from the original chorus line. Source: Cydney Lee, *Billboard*, August 3, 2022, https://www.billboard.com/music/features/steve-lacy-bad-habit-billboard-august-2022-chartbreaker-interview-1235121728/.

  - Gordon: songwriting
  - Castellanos: songwriting
- **Discrepancy:** The infobox spells the name "Britanny," while the liner-note credits spell it "Brittany."

## Production, Mixing, and Mastering

- **Producer:** Steve Lacy.
- **Mixing:** Neal Pogue at Hot Purple Petting Zoo studio, Los Angeles. Pogue mixed the guitar riff as the song's main focus (Paul Tingen, *Sound on Sound*, December 2022, https://www.soundonsound.com/techniques/inside-track-steve-lacy-bad-habit).
- **Mastering:** Mike Bozzi of Bernie Grundman Mastering.

## Musical Details

- Key of F minor, tempo 84–88 BPM, vocal range C4–C6 (sheet music, Musicnotes, August 1, 2022).
- Built on a warped guitar riff, funky bassline, drums, and synths. Lacy sings in falsetto throughout.

## Release and Chart Facts

- **Release:** June 29, 2022, via RCA Records, as the second single from *Gemini Rights* (album released July 15, 2022).
- **Music video:** Directed by Julian Klincewicz, released the same day as the single.
- **TikTok:** Over 710,000 videos used the song by January 2023. A fan-made sped-up version appeared in over 430,000 videos (Conor Murray, *Forbes*, January 18, 2023).
- **Hot 100 debut:** Entered at No. 100 in July 2022, Lacy's first chart entry.
- **Genre charts:** Chart dated September 10, 2022, it became the first song to top both Hot R&B/Hip-Hop Songs and Hot Rock & Alternative Songs (Kevin Rutherford, *Billboard*, September 6, 2022). It later topped five genre charts at once.
- **No. 1:** Chart dated October 3, 2022, it displaced "As It Was" by Harry Styles, which had led for 15 weeks. It was Lacy's first No. 1 (Ben Sisario, *The New York Times*, October 3, 2022, https://www.nytimes.com/2022/10/03/arts/music/steve-lacy-bad-habit-billboard-chart.html).
- **International peaks:** ARIA (Australia) No. 3; UK Singles No. 8 (October 2022); Irish Singles top 10; Canada Hot 100 No. 10.
